title: Parity of a sign power
statement: For every Boolean value $b$ and natural number $c$, the $c$th power of its sign encoding is the sign encoding itself when $c$ is odd, and is $1$ when $c$ is even.
replaced:
For every bit $b\in\{0,1\}$ and natural number $c$, setting $s(b)=(-1)^b$ gives
\[
s(b)^c=\begin{cases}s(b)&\text{if }c\text{ is odd},\\1&\text{if }c\text{ is even}.\end{cases}
\]
